decision: The direct ordinary polynomial EEA route computes omega/sigma_prime modulo sigma correctly, but its optimistic sample-path estimate is 5.09x the replacement budget on average. Do not build this exact route as a reversible circuit. This does not rule out a faster or integrated transformation.
scope: Classical sample-path arithmetic count only. No reversible circuit, fixed-branch upper bound, workspace/cleanup, full DQI schedule, official verifier, or submission.
